paper.citation: Dimitriadis, T., Dümbgen, L., Henzi, A., Puke, M. and Ziegel, J. (2023). Honest calibration assessment for binary outcome predictions. Biometrika, 110(3), 663–680. DOI: 10.1093/biomet/asac068.
paper.venue: Biometrika (formal publication, 2023); arXiv preprint v2 is the checked DGP version
paper.source_locator: DGP source actually checked in arXiv:2203.04065v2 (2022-11-02), PDF p.8, Section 5, item 3 (Kink): linear interpolation through (0,0), (0.2+0.8s,0.2), and (1,1); X~U[0,1] and Y~Bernoulli{p_s(X)} are specified on the same page. Supplementary Material PDF pp.17–20 covers rounding, application details, and proofs and does not state a changed kink DGP. The paper gives replication URL https://github.com/marius-cp/replication_DDHPZ22 but no fixed code commit. Formal Biometrika DGP differences were not checked.

mechanism.name: Kink binary regression functions from Dimitriadis et al. (2023)

generation_equations.label: Degenerate s=1 convention
generation_equations.expression: a_1=1; p_1(x)=0.2x for 0<=x<1 and p_1(1)=1 by library convention

sampling.dependence: iid across observations; no cluster, panel, network, or within-unit dependence

assumptions: Independent and identically distributed individual observations (X_i,Y_i).
X has the source distribution Uniform[0,1] and the fixed query x*=0.5 lies in its support.
Given X=x, Y is Bernoulli with success probability p_s(x); for s<1 the two linear pieces meet at a_s and have endpoint values 0 and 1.
At s=1, the source anchors have coincident x-coordinate a_1=1; this contribution uses the declared library convention p_1(1)=1 and p_1(x)=0.2x for x<1.
For every declared scenario s in [0,1], p_s is nondecreasing on [0,1] under the stated endpoint convention, matching the monotonicity condition used for the source simultaneous-band method.
The scalar truth is evaluated under the known DGP; no causal exchangeability, treatment, mediator, or interference assumption is relevant.

properties.notes: The only covariate is X, so total and effective dimensions are both one. There are no interaction terms. The regression function is piecewise linear with a kink at a_s=0.2+0.8s for every s>0; s=0 gives the diagonal p_0(x)=x. The s=1 endpoint convention creates a jump only at the single point x=1 (left limit 0.2, assigned endpoint value 1), which has probability zero under continuous Uniform sampling. The binary outcome link is Bernoulli with this conditional probability.

estimand.name: m_s(x*) = E[Y | X=x*] = p_s(x*)
estimand.definition: Noncausal nonparametric regression function at the fixed query x*=0.5 for a selected source scenario s in {0,0.1,...,1}; p_s is the piecewise-linear interpolation through (0,0), (a_s,0.2), (1,1), with a_s=0.2+0.8s. This is a conditional Bernoulli probability, not an intervention effect or a prediction interval.

truth.expression: Noncausal nonparametric regression function at the fixed query x*=0.5 for a selected source scenario s in {0,0.1,...,1}; p_s is the piecewise-linear interpolation through (0,0), (a_s,0.2), (1,1), with a_s=0.2+0.8s. This is a conditional Bernoulli probability, not an intervention effect or a prediction interval.
truth.derivation: Piecewise-linear evaluation at fixed x*=0.5 using the source knot a_s=0.2+0.8s; independently checked from the corresponding segment slope/intercept. Default s=0.5 gives (0.2/0.6)*0.5=1/6.

adaptations: Register the source shape grid s=0,0.1,...,1 as eleven named scenarios and use s=0.5 as the default; these are source parameter settings, not new mechanism families.
Expose the scalar NRI target p_s(0.5)=E[Y|X=0.5] required by the collection interface. The source studies simultaneous confidence bands over x, not this scalar truth hook.

At the source-degenerate endpoint s=1 (a=1), define p_1(1)=1 as the library convention while retaining the first-segment value p_1(x)=0.2x for x<1. This changes only the single endpoint value under continuous Uniform[0,1] sampling, but it changes an endpoint query truth.
Run the collection smoke check instead of the source's 1000-replication coverage experiment; no confidence band, bootstrap, or coverage result is claimed.
